tokens.name: topaz-300
tokens.usage: Gem highlight facet. Primary fill in dark mode; never text on light grounds (1.9:1).

tokens.name: topaz-500
tokens.usage: Gem body facet, the signature blue. Large fields, illustration, cover blocks. Not for text on white (2.95:1).

tokens.name: topaz-600
tokens.usage: Gem side facet. Secondary fields and chart series 2.

tokens.name: topaz-700
tokens.usage: Gem shadow facet. Chart series 3, pressed states on brand fields.

tokens.name: topaz-800
tokens.usage: Gem deepest facet. The one text-safe brand blue on white (4.9:1): links, primary buttons.

tokens.name: topaz-900
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed for topaz-800; brand text on topaz-50 (5.6:1).

tokens.name: topaz-50
tokens.usage: Pale topaz tint for highlighted panels and selected rows on light grounds.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: The wordmark ink. Headlines and body text on light grounds (14.2:1 on white).

tokens.name: imperial
tokens.usage: Imperial topaz, the warm counter-accent. Small doses only: one highlight, badge or rule per view. Text on it is graphite (6.8:1).

tokens.name: imperial-ink
tokens.usage: Imperial as text or icon on light grounds (5.3:1 on white).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Section bands, code blocks, table headers.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and menus; on light grounds separate them with border, not shadow.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers and card edges (decorative, carries no meaning).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; 3:1 on surface in light, 4.0:1 in dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and headline text on surface, surface-sunken and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on any surface (5.6:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, active states, the focus ring.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (4.9:1 light, 9.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The signature blue as a field or graphic in both themes. Not for text on light grounds (2.95:1); display text on dark grounds only (6.3:1).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Selected rows and callout panels; text on it is ink or topaz-900 in light.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Warm accent fill; pair with on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status text and icons; always with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions; always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: cover lines, hero statements.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: All-caps eyebrows and labels in SemiBold, the weight of the wordmark letters.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; control padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page margins on desktop; slide margins.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero and cover breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Brand fields, slides, images: the gem is cut sharp, so large surfaces stay square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, dialogs. The maximum; no pills.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Floating menus and popovers only; cards use border.
